#  23434 - Shell and Membrane Structures Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **23434 - module is no longer offered from WS 2026/27**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Shell and Membrane Structures**  |  
|  Schalen und Membranen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr.-Ing. Firl, Matthias 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Basic knowledge of Structural analysis and design of shells, shaped with simple structures, ability for the formulation and solution of the principal differential equations.**Application**
  * Modelling of more complex structures and structural analysis by application of Finite-Element software within a project.

**Abilities**
  * Getting well known, how to develop a suitable shape of shell in compliance with the used building material

 |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Structural behaviour of shell structures, assumption of technical shell theory, membrane theory of revolving shells, bending theory of cylindrical shells, solution of selected structural shell problems, derivation of a finite element for revolving shells
  * Minimal surfaces, Linearisation (Force density method), geometric nonlinearity of deformations, Eigenfrequencies, Optimisation of Topology- and Boundary conditions, specifics of construction and detailing; special aspects of using Finite-Element software for structural analysis of shells

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Hake, Meskouris, Statik der Flächentragwerke, Springer Verlag Berlin, 2001
  * Dierkes, U., u.a.: Minimal surfaces I and II. Grundlehren der mathematischen Wissenschaften 295-296, Springer, Berlin, Heidelberg, 1992
  * Linkwitz, K. and Schek, H.-J.: Einige Bemerkungen zur Berechnung von vorgespannten Seilnetzkonstruktionen, Ingenieur Archiv, 40, S. 145-158, 1971
  * Schock, H.-J., Sails, Foils and Membranes: Innovative Structures in Textile Architecture, Birkhäuser, Basel, 1997

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 90 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | SS1In the event that the module cannot be taught or tested according to the present description (e.g. for reasons of infection protection), the alternatives communicated on relevant platforms (e.g. homepage or Moodle) apply.  |  
| Module Components:  | Participation in one of the offered seminars.  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 14.07.2015 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
